name: cece-african-hair-braiding
description: Salon booking + beauty supply e-commerce (React, Express, MongoDB, Stripe) for Cece African Hair Braiding

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev:memory --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
